name: Three-stage review and execution workflow
objective: 每天只筛选 1-2 笔最合适的限价机会；由 AI 综合判断挂单、止损、仓位与风险，不使用固定分数或固定 RR 一票否决。

new_position_sizing.description: Reference sizes only. AI chooses final size from entry quality, stop distance, cash, concentration, events and current exposure.

order_instruction_policy.note: 只要 AI 判断限价、止损、仓位和风险组合合适，就可以创建非 live 的 IBKR order instruction；最终仍需用户在 IBKR 客户端确认。

stages.purpose: Use completed EOD bars to rank themes/candidates and define next-session scenarios.
Refresh news/events/gaps and broker snapshots; produce provisional entries only.
Use first 15-45 minutes of price discovery to select entry mode and create/adjust executable instruction.

execution_timing.rule: Post-close selects WHAT; premarket decides WHETHER the setup remains valid; opening confirmation decides HOW/WHERE to enter.

pullback.description: Normal pullback into support/breakout level with defined stop.

breakout_retest.description: Breakout holds, then first retest confirms old resistance as support.

momentum.description: For exceptional relative strength when no deep pullback occurs. Require opening confirmation and smaller initial size; never chase blindly.

execution_metrics.purpose: Measure whether conservative limits avoid losses or systematically miss winners.
